'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• S-I1.1 — Inventory Orchestration
  Owner: head_of_supply_chain
  Trigger: inv.dio.days > 0.25%
  Impact: High
  Expected: -5.0–-15.0 days
  Confidence: High
  · DETECT sustained DIO deviation for this SKU/location
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant inventory driver (excess, stockout, obsolescence, planning) for this SKU/location
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this SKU/location
  ⚠ Trigger only if OTIF remains within agreed tolerance
  ⚠ Do not trigger if DIO increase is driven by approved buffer build-up

• S-I1.2 — Inventory Rightsizing
  Owner: inventory_manager
  Trigger: inv.dio.days > 40days
  Impact: High
  Expected: -10.0–-30.0 days
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify SKUs with structurally high DIO
  · Adjust safety stock and reorder parameters
  · Execute rebalancing or clearance actions
  ⚠ Trigger only if stockout rate remains below tolerance
  ⚠ Do not trigger if OTIF deterioration is observed

• S-I1.3 — Stockout Prevention
  Owner: supply_planner
  Trigger: inv.stockout.pct > 5.0%
  Impact: High
  Expected: -1.0–-5.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · Identify SKUs with rising stockout risk
  · Correct replenishment parameters or trigger expedites
  · Reallocate inventory across locations if needed
  ⚠ Trigger only if DIO is not already above upper tolerance
  ⚠ Do not trigger if stockouts are demand-spike driven and approved

• S-I1.4 — Obsolescence & Excess Reduction
  Owner: inventory_controller
  Trigger: inv.obsolete.pct > 10.0%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: -2.0–-8.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify obsolete and aging inventory beyond demand horizon
  · Block further replenishment
  · Execute liquidation, return, or disposal actions
  ⚠ Trigger only if items are outside active demand horizon
  ⚠ Do not trigger if obsolescence is driven by approved lifecycle transitions

• S-I1.5 — Forecast & Planning Stabilisation
  Owner: head_of_demand_planning
  Trigger: plan.forecast.accuracy.pct < 60.0%
  Impact: Medium
  Expected: 5.0–15.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify SKUs with persistent forecast instability
  · Review planning inputs, overrides, and cadence
  · Enforce planning governance and parameter discipline
  ⚠ Trigger only if forecast error is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if volatility is driven by approved promotions'
